import { View, Text } from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { Sparkles, Zap, Shield } from "lucide-react-native";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";

const features = [
  { icon: Zap, title: "Fast", description: "Lightning-quick performance on any device." },
  { icon: Shield, title: "Secure", description: "Your data is protected with industry-grade security." },
  { icon: Sparkles, title: "Beautiful", description: "A clean, modern interface you'll love using." },
];

export default function WelcomeScreen() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaView className="flex-1 bg-background">
      <View className="flex-1 justify-center px-6">
        <View className="items-center">
          <View className="h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-3xl bg-primary">
            <Sparkles size={36} className="text-primary-foreground" />
          </View>
          <Text className="mt-6 text-center text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
            Welcome to Snips
          </Text>
          <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-muted-foreground">
            Everything you need, beautifully simple.
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-12 gap-5">
          {features.map(({ icon: Icon, title, description }) => (
            <View key={title} className="flex-row items-center gap-4">
              <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary/10">
                <Icon size={22} className="text-primary" />
              </View>
              <View className="flex-1">
                <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">{title}</Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</Text>
              </View>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>

        <View className="mt-12 gap-3">
          <Button size="lg">Get Started</Button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="lg">
            I already have an account
          </Button>
        </View>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
